eligibility.reference_excerpt: 大學部及研究生皆可申請 大學部不得申請: 數學系、計算機應用與科學學系、人工智能學院、電子信 息專業僅收台港澳籍學生申請

language_requirement.reference_excerpt: 無

partner_documents.reference_excerpt: 無須紙本資料 ⚫ 請自行去醫院做體檢並完成體檢表 ⚫ 必須有《港澳居民來往內地通行證》或《臺灣居民來往大陸通行證》 ⚫ 姊妹校申請兩階段: 第一階段: 請同學將以下六個檔按照順序統整成一個 PDF傳到上面信箱 1. 學生申請表（必須貼照片）-- 最新申請表格式後續於雲端下載 2. 個人履歷一份（格式不拘）-- 之前第一階段校內審查資料的履歷即可 3. 臺胞證或回鄉證掃描件（若申請時未持有證件，可在第二階段 補交）如果目前還沒有的也請寄資料來時另外說明臺胞證日後 補交 4. 已修讀課程正式成績單一份—第一階段校內的中文歷年成績單 5. 教師推薦信一份（須推薦人親筆簽名） 6. 交換學習計畫一份（1000字以內） 7. 推薦表(由國際處承辦人填寫) 第二階段: 1.醫療/意外保險證明一份 2.體檢表（常規體檢，胸透為必檢專案）-- 請於雲端下載 3.電子照片一張（照片格式須為 JPG，大小為 50kb-500kb之間，簡體字命名 為：姓名+學校）

additional_info.reference_excerpt: 交換生申請表 ⚫ 交換生日程表

notes.reference_excerpt: 不得跨系申請(若科系名稱類似可申請) ⚫ 體育課、 通識課不開放選課。 ⚫ 選課所選的還會由個別院系去協調，不一定所有選的課都可以修到 ⚫ 一學期(one semester)至少修兩學分 ⚫ 學校宿舍姊妹校會協助安排，住宿費需額外繳交 ⚫ Application deadline申請截止日: 2023/10/20 ⚫ 成績單將於新學期開學前三周內寄出，23年春季成績單將於23年秋季學期 （即 2023年 9月中旬）寄出，無法提前獲得。 ⚫ 暫行隔離政策：根據目前南京市防疫部門的隔離要求，境外中高風險地 區入境將執行 7+3+4的隔離政策，即：7天海關隔離+3天居家隔離+4天 健康監測，期間按照隔離要求進行核酸檢測，交換學生申請入校，理應 提供：2次隔離證明 ⚫ +48小時內核酸檢測報告（具體操作以入境時的隔離要求為准）。

evidence.excerpt: すべての交換留学生対象:「日本語能力自己評価表」 （書類を記入する前に、必ず「日本語能力自己評価 の説明」をお読みください。 オンラインの SPOT テストを受験し、その結果（PDF）を最終提出期限までにオンライン出願フォーム を通じて提出してください。 龍谷大学の 1 年は 2 つの学期からなります。第 1 学期は 4 月～9 月、第 2 学期は 9 月～3 月です。 すべての授業終了後、試験期間が設けられています。オリエンテーションウィーク開始から試験期間 終了まで龍谷大学で学修できない方の出願はお断り致します（学期途中での参加、修了はできません。 また、試験を受けずに帰国した場合、単位は認定されません） 。 ■オリエンテーションウィーク： 2027 年 4 月 1 日～5 日（予定） ◎2027 年度 第 1 学期：2027 年 4 月～2027 年 9 月（夏期休業：2027 年 8 月上旬～9 月中旬） ※最終退寮日は 2027 年 8 月 10 日（予定）です。最終退寮日は変更する場合があります。 ◎2027 年度 第 2 学期：2027 年 9 月～2028 年 3 月（春期休業：2028 年 2 月上旬～3 月下旬） ※最終退寮日は 2028 年 3 月 17 日（予定）です。 ※夏期休暇、春期休暇中も退寮日までは寮に住むことができます。 2027 年度第 1 学期の入学式は 4 月 2 日です。 新留学生は、 龍谷大学の学生寮に2027 年 3 月 25 日（木） から入寮することができる予定です。入寮日： 2027 年 3 月 25 日（木） 交換留学生は、2026 年 4 月に開設された 「Ryukoku Japan Studies Program（JSP）」 を中心に学修 を進めます。JSP は、 本学の理念である 「まごころ」 （誠実・ 慈悲・ 利他） の精神を基盤に、 日本語学習、 国内学生や他国からの留学生と共に課題解決型学修 （PBL） を行う国際共修科目、 日本社会・文化・産業 に関する 3 つの科目群を組み合わせて学べるカリキュラムです JSP では、日本語で開講される科目や選択科目に加え、英語で開講される科目も用意されており、日本 語未習者から日本語能力試験（JLPT）受験を目指す上級者まで幅広い学生が履修可能です。フィールド トリップや文化活動、地域社会との交流を通じて、学術的にも個人的にも大きな成長を得られるプログ ラムです。さらに、学部・大学院開講科目の履修も可能です（英語開講科目：全員対象、日本語開講科 目：JSP-Ⅳ・Ⅴのみ）。1 学期あたり JSP 科目 15 単位以上の履修が必要となります。 龍谷大学 学年暦 龍谷大学への到着日と入寮日 日本語能力自己評価表および SPOT テスト結果の提出について Ryukoku Japan Studies Program（JSP）について

evidence.excerpt: 2027 年 9 月 10 日起开放（暂 定、有变更的可能）。 宿舍入住日： 2027 年 3 月 25 日（暂定） 交換留学生将以 2027 年 4 月开设的「Ryukoku Japan Studies Program（JSP）」为中心开展学习。 JSP 课程以本校理念“真心”（诚实、慈悲、利他）的精神为基础，结合日语学习、与日本本地学生及其他 国家留学生共同进行的课题解决型学习（PBL）的 国际共修学习课程， 以及围绕日本社会、 文化与产业的三 个课程模块，构建出一个综合性的学习体系。 在 JSP 课程中，除了以日语授课的课程和选修课程外，还充分提供了以英语授课的课程。从日语零基础到 日本语能力测试（JLPT）高级程度的同学，皆可选修本课程。 通过实地考察、文化交流活动以及与当地社会的互动，学生不仅能够在学术上取得成果，也能在个人成长 方面获得宝贵经验。 此外，若符合一定条件，还可选修本校本科及研究生院开设的课程（英语授课课程面向所有交换生开放； 日语授课课程仅限JSP-Ⅳ、Ⅴ学生选修）。每学期需修满JSP 课程15 个学分以上。 龍谷大学 学年历 龍谷大学的报到日及宿舍入住日 关于提交《日语能力自我评估表》及 SPOT 测试结果 Ryukoku Japan Studies Program（JSP）的介绍

evidence.excerpt: 2027 年 3 月 25 日（木） から入寮することができる予定です。入寮日： 2027 年 3 月 25 日（木） 交換留学生は、2026 年 4 月に開設された 「Ryukoku Japan Studies Program（JSP）」 を中心に学修 を進めます。JSP は、 本学の理念である 「まごころ」 （誠実・ 慈悲・ 利他） の精神を基盤に、 日本語学習、 国内学生や他国からの留学生と共に課題解決型学修 （PBL） を行う国際共修科目、 日本社会・文化・産業 に関する 3 つの科目群を組み合わせて学べるカリキュラムです JSP では、日本語で開講される科目や選択科目に加え、英語で開講される科目も用意されており、日本 語未習者から日本語能力試験（JLPT）受験を目指す上級者まで幅広い学生が履修可能です。フィールド トリップや文化活動、地域社会との交流を通じて、学術的にも個人的にも大きな成長を得られるプログ ラムです。さらに、学部・大学院開講科目の履修も可能です（英語開講科目：全員対象、日本語開講科 目：JSP-Ⅳ・Ⅴのみ）。1 学期あたり JSP 科目 15 単位以上の履修が必要となります。 龍谷大学 学年暦 龍谷大学への到着日と入寮日 日本語能力自己評価表および SPOT テスト結果の提出について Ryukoku Japan Studies Program（JSP）について

Similar to "major" classes, you have to register for graduate classes in person when you are on campus the first week of the semester. Please have a backup plan as well since spots are not guaranteed. Nevertheless, spaces in graduate classes typically are not a problem unlike undergraduate classes. OKAY, I need to ask for permission, but how can I find out the e-mail address of a teacher? It can be difficult to register for classes when you need permission, and often you might miss a class that only meets once a week. You can contact professors in advance to begin asking for permission, even if you have to wait until the 2nd round of course registration. evidence.excerpt: SPRING 2027 semester. AUGUST 1 - OCTOBER 30 202 6 Nomination & Application Period P rospective students will be nominated by their home university through our online nomination system. Once a nomination is made, nominated students will be sent an email with further instructions regarding the online application. The online application (including the document submission procedure via Google Form) must be completed within the nomination and application period. DECEMBER 202 6 A dmission Packet After reviewing all application documents, HUFS will send all prospective students the admission packet (PDF files) by email. Students must contact and confirm with the local Korean Embassy or Consulate to see if any additional documents are required for visa application. This may differ across different countries so please make sure to check beforehand. Once students have prepared all necessary documents, they must take all necessary paperwork along with the HUFS admission packet to the Korean Embassy or Consulate in order to apply for a D-2-6 (exchange student) or D-2-8 (visiting student) visa .

evidence.excerpt: Students who stay at HCMUT for academic exchange period are required to obtain a study visa before entering Vietnam, following the procedures below. 1. After the Learning Agreement has been finalized and signed by all parties, HCMUT will begin the internal process of preparing the required visa documents for incoming students. 2. HCMUT will submit the student's visa application documents to the Vietnam Immigration Department to obtain a Visa Approval Letter on the student's behalf. 3. Once approved, HCMUT will send the student a scanned copy of the Visa Approval Letter together with the Letter of Acceptance. 4. The student must present their original passport and the Visa Approval Letter to the Vietnamese Embassy or Consulate specified in the application form, either in their home country or in another country, to obtain a study visa. Notes: - The Visa Approval Letter issued by the Immigration Department will enable the students to obtain a visa shortly. - The incoming students had better NOT apply for a tourist visa themselves before receiving the Visa Approval Letter. With our partner Studapart, access hundreds of exclusive offers: studios, flatshares, homestays… and benefit from personalized support throughout your rent! housing.u-bordeaux-montaigne.fr From applying to booking, take all your steps online on the platform. To get started, click on “ Tenant space ” and sign up using your school’s login credentials or your personal email address. Book accommodation online to benefit from the Studapart Guarantee and support from a team of multilingual experts available 6/7d. You don’t have a guarantor living in France ? Studapart can replace your guarantor over the whole duration of your stay. A guarantor is a person bringing financial security and attesting you are creditworthy. It’s difficult to rent a place in France without a French guarantor. In most cases, student residences and landlords require that your guarantor earns income in France. You can get the Studapart Guarantee directly on the platform and add it to your rental application to find accommodation on the Studapart platform or anywhere else! footer-script

evidence.excerpt: These three programs are offered to undergraduate and graduate students who are completing at least the first year of higher education in the area of ​​ information and communication technologies (ICT) . Overview EPITA has signed academic mobility cooperation agreements with 106 distinguished universities in 48 different countries. Currently, EPITA has 94 bilateral cooperation agreements for Erasmus and non-Erasmus exchanges. In addition, there are 16 mobility agreements for the Study Abroad program with recognized higher education institutions in mainly Anglo-Saxon countries. Incoming students can combine scientific courses in the area of ​​informatics and management with French language and culture courses at EPITA. The academic plans can have between 15 and 30 ECTS credits depending on the requirements of their home university. For EPITA students, international experience is a requirement to obtain the engineering diploma in France. As part of the study plan, EPITA students have the possibility of studying for a semester at one of the 86 universities with which EPITA has a cooperation agreement. These academic mobilities take place mainly during the fourth semester of the sophomore year. Junior and senior year students can also complete an international academic mobility. Outgoing students must validate 30 ECTS credits at the end of the academic mobility. Exchange The exchange program allows students coming from universities with which EPITA has a bilateral cooperation agreement to study courses taught entirely in English at EPITA and enjoy an incredible cultural life in the French capital. evidence.excerpt: Step 4: make payment of the tuition (ONLY for free-movers and free-based students) The tuition fee should be transferred to AMU bank account indicated in the pre-acceptance letter and the proof of payment should be sent to International Office. Emails addresses will be included in the preacceptance letter. Step 5: provide nomination letter If you are an exchange student on the basis of a bilateral agreement or any other agreement or fund, please provide the International Office with this document via e-mail. Step 6: admission decision The final decision of admission is issued after sending proof of payment to the International Office via email (in case of free-movers and fee-based students). The decision of admission is issued within 14 working days after receiving the proof of payment. Step 7: provide your course selection Upon receiving your admission letter, please contact the International Ofiice in order to provide them with the names of the AMU-PIE courses you chose to study at AMU together with a written consent of your home University. Your home University should agree for the selection of AMU-PIE courses you made and set the minimum number of ECTS points. Step 8: upload your photo for student ID After receiving the admission decision, your application online will be acceptance and you will then have a chance to upload a photo for students ID.

evidence.excerpt: at least 15 ECTS per semester. It is not recommendable to take more than 40 ECTS per semester. Learning Approach FHNW School of Business counts with mixed classes where regular local students and incoming students work on group assignments together. The usual size of classes is rather small which allows everyone to interact and participate in class discussions. To make the semester’s planification easier and to be prepared in those discussions, each course has a semester programme which is available at the beginning of the semester. Grants Conditions Students are required to sign a Grant Agreement (declaration of honour) before arriving. This agreement will be available on Mobility-Online. To be eligible for the SEMP, students must agree the enclosed programme of study ("Learning Agreement for Studies") with their home and host universities before the start of the mobility. Any changes to the programme of study originally agreed must be documented in an updated “Learning Agreement for Studies”. Incoming students must take a minimum of 15 ECTS per exchange semester. Students must be residents in the country of the host university during their study. The minimum duration of a student mobility for studies is three months. More information concerning the exact calculation of the stay can be found in the declaration of honour which must be signed by the students. evidence.excerpt: Accommodation Contract The Accommodation Contract has to be signed without undue delay, during the first working day after the checking-in at the HoR. A resident has to visit the Accommodation Officer during office hours. Along with the Accommodation Contract the resident receives the Halls of Residence Rules and Regulations . The accommodation contract is concluded for the whole duration of a semester or academic year, i.e.: Winter (fall) semester : from September 1 to January 31 of a particular year Summer (spring) semester : from February 1 to June 30 of a particular year whole academic year : from September 1 to June 30 of a particular year BEFORE DEPARTURE As soon as the student knows the date of departure, (s)he has to inform the Accommodation Officer about it. If the Accommodation Contract has to be terminated before the agreed date, mutual agreement in writing has to be concluded at least 3 months before the student’s departure. Otherwise, the deposit will not be returned to the student. A cleaned room has to be shown to the cleaning lady before 13:00 on working days and then handed over to the Accommodation Assistant or receptionist. The check-out from the Residence Hall can be done only during office hours on working day
